webNotes: New in 2.4.12: a dedication to Emmi — "For Emmi" — on the front of the app, in Tony and Autumn's words. It shows on the home screen until dismissed, and re-opens any time from Settings / About. Words only — no photo. Beta — just for Tony and Muse. Five new mood poses for her: sad, happy, thankful, grateful, and excited — in the Poses menu and by asking in chat. Everything from 2.4.10 still stands: two doors, two keys (on first launch the app asks who is opening it — Tony's path is the PIN prompt, only he ever sees it; the guest path is a guest-code prompt, never any PIN screen, and guests only ever see the shared side). Guest codes: one code per guest, and each guest keeps the same code — Tony's decision; Tony makes, changes, and takes away guest codes in Settings (behind his PIN). A guest cannot make their own new code. Also new in 2.4.10: a Rules & Appreciation page, linked from Settings and from the Her World menu — the full constitution in her own words, and thanks to Tony, Muse (Shadow), Perplexity, and Aimmianna herself. Push-to-talk deep links (?voice=1 / ?chat=1), the PIN guard, the Her World menu with the constitution, the Perplexity backup toggle, and world backup in Settings all still stand. Rule 1 never changes, no exceptions, not even by Tony.

sharedRelease.text: Apartment Life and shared companion memory affect both devices. Check for updates on your iPhone and Android.

notes: Fixes the Android app reloading over and over on a new install, and stops the live wallpaper from overwriting newer changes made in the app.
